bLU

bLU

bLU is Giovani Baroni's debut solo album — a conceptual, narrative record designed to be listened to as a single continuous journey, from beginning to end.

Tracklist

  1. 1. Ambiência Aquática No 5
  2. 2. Peixes Estranhos
  3. 3. Norte
  4. 4. Mecânica dos Fluidos
  5. 5. Fishy Boy
  6. 6. O Mundo dos Sonhos
  7. 7. Paseo Largo
  8. 8. O Bicho que Sabia Demais
  9. 9. Efervescente
  10. 10. O Rio

Credits

  • Written and produced by Giovani Baroni
  • Bass and mixing by Pedro Serapicos (Berlin)
  • Drums by Bianca Predieri (São Paulo)
  • Guest vocals on Efervescente: Jorge Sultzer
  • Fishy Boy co-written with Ricardo Baroni and Mardem Humberto
  • Piano developed with Eduardo [UPDATE: last name]
  • Video production: Léo Lopes, Luca Tornato
